title: The landed-with-no-work-rows warning fires on items claimed and worked normally, because it reads only this host's spool
goal: bl_land's no-work-rows warning does not fire for an item whose work rows distill already consumed from the spool (it reads the store as well as the spool), with a test named no_work_rows_after_distill that plants a consumed spool. Observed on both lands of TK-ftucvr5v and on ST-6untv3xn's, although all were claimed normally.
repro_reason: the false positive needs a consumed spool and a landed item, which only the new test can plant; the text match only shows the consumed-spool case is not handled
